name: Omaglass
author: Ronny Iversen
description: Glass terminals on every theme: frosted panes that sample the wallpaper only, a contact shadow where a pane lies over another window, and per-window looks you can cycle from the bar or a key.

barWidget.description: Shows the focused window's glass look; click cycles the looks, right-click cycles readability.

schema.label: Terminals are glass
schema.description: foot, ghostty, alacritty and kitty windows become glass panes (the pane shows through the terminal's own alpha).

schema.label: Sample the wallpaper only
schema.description: Glass is made from the wallpaper, never from windows beneath (needs the patched hyprglass).

schema.label: Chilled windows are glass
schema.description: Windows floated by Omachill get the glass too.

schema.label: Glass on the bar and menus
schema.description: The shell's bar, menus, OSD and notifications get the frost.

schema.label: Frost
schema.description: Blur strength of the default glass. 30 hides everything behind the pane; 1 keeps the wallpaper recognisable.

schema.label: Shadows
schema.description: Contact: one soft shadow system on every theme — the focused window gets a plain shadow of the contact shadow's range at twice its strength, an unfocused window casts one only where it lies over another window, a lone one none. Theme: Hyprland's shadows exactly as the theme sets them, no contact shadow. Flat: no shadows at all.

schema.label: Shadow range
schema.description: How far the shadows reach, in pixels (the focused window's and the contact shadow).

schema.label: Shadow strength
schema.description: Opacity of the contact shadow, percent; the focused window's shadow is twice this.

schema.label: Shadow only where it lies over a window
schema.description: On: the shadow fades out at the underlying window's outline and the part of the pane resting on the wallpaper casts nothing. Off: a full ring whenever the pane overlaps anything.

schema.label: Terminal alpha, light themes (%)
schema.description: The terminal's own background alpha on light themes; the frost only reads below about 70. 0 leaves foot.ini alone. A theme that ships its own alpha wins.

schema.label: Milky look alpha (%)
schema.description: Terminal alpha in the milky look: frost still visible, text on a lighter ground.

schema.label: Clear look alpha (%)
schema.description: Terminal alpha in the clear look: sharp wallpaper through the pane.

schema.label: Key: readability
schema.description: Cycles glass → milky → solid for the focused window (empty = no key).

schema.label: Key: looks
schema.description: Cycles clear → sheer → native → contrast → block for the focused window (empty = no key).

schema.label: Notify on change
schema.description: Show a notification naming the look and the window.

schema.label: Hide widget on the default look
schema.description: Only show the bar icon while the focused window is in a non-default look.
